$comment: Cover theme lines (by Mulank) and the glossary. Draft text by Claude, for numerologist review.

blocks.summary.theme.1: A born leader, here to begin things and show the way.
blocks.summary.theme.2: A gentle connector, here to bring people together.
blocks.summary.theme.3: A wise guide, here to learn and to teach.
blocks.summary.theme.4: A practical innovator, here to build in new ways.
blocks.summary.theme.5: A quick communicator, here to connect and explore.
blocks.summary.theme.6: A loving creator, here to care and beautify.
blocks.summary.theme.7: A deep seeker, here to understand.
blocks.summary.theme.8: A patient builder, here to create what lasts.
blocks.summary.theme.9: A courageous giver, here to act and to serve.
blocks.glossary.mulank: Mulank (driver): the number of the day of birth, showing everyday nature.
blocks.glossary.bhagyank: Bhagyank (conductor): the sum of the whole birth date, showing life's direction.
blocks.glossary.chaldean: Chaldean: the letter system used for the name number in Indian practice.
blocks.glossary.pythagorean: Pythagorean: the Western letter system, used for the core four numbers.
blocks.glossary.compound: Compound: the two-digit total before reduction, with its own meaning.
blocks.glossary.master_number: Master number: 11, 22 or 33, kept unreduced where the rules say so.
blocks.glossary.karmic_debt: Karmic debt: 13, 14, 16 or 19 appearing in a total, showing a lesson to work on.
blocks.glossary.loshu: Lo Shu: a 3 by 3 magic square used to map the digits of the birth date.
blocks.glossary.kua: Kua: a number from the birth year and gender that gives good and bad directions.
blocks.glossary.personal_year: Personal year: the theme of the current year, from 1 to 9.
blocks.glossary.pinnacle: Pinnacle: one of four long periods of life, each with its own theme.
blocks.glossary.dasha: Dasha: the numerology period ruled by one number for as many years as its value.
